{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}


::: {#exr-goat-swim-closet}

Use `r xf("fig-both-objectives")` to argue that a negative sloping line corresponds to a price of one objective in terms of the other. 

Then show that, once you have agreed on a price, point on the curve that is optimal can be identified as the one where the slope of the curve matches the agreed-upon price.

:::
